firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: signature bars + range map visible at first paint, phone in header and primary, quiet secondary, Sample proof line; h1 4 lines at 1440 (-0.5), trade not in h1, hero exactly 900px so nothing peeks (-0.5). 390-first.jpg: h1 4 lines, both actions above fold, signature card hidden under mobile bar.

distinctiveness.notes: Drop-Season Bars in hero, plates, ledger, tools, field notes, footer (1440-full-*.jpg), organising when to book; unlike gutter A/B 1440-first.jpg. Tells: 01-08 / 01-04 numbering and an eyebrow over every h2 (1440-full-3/4/5.jpg, -0.5); only 2 of 6 review cards carry the tick (1440-full-4.jpg).

type.notes: Rethink Sans + Newsreader italic Latin names, real scale contrast (1440-first.jpg). Rule cuts descenders under #svc-h and #visit-h (1440-full-3.jpg, 1440-full-5.jpg, -0.5); 4+ tracked caps labels in hero view (1440-first.jpg, -0.5); sub-13px legend and month letters.

layout.notes: Tone map alternates cleanly with no touching darks; sticky-index plates, dense ledger, full-bleed break (1440-full-1/2.jpg). Tools grid lopsided, left card ends ~160px short (1440-full-3.jpg, -0.5); services index and visit steps are template shapes, nothing breaks the grid (1440-full-3/5.jpg).

photo.notes: Only two photos; the gutter frame is a 150x180 inset (1440-first.jpg, -0.5); break is generic leaves-on-water with a different grade from the hero (1440-rm-full-2.jpg, -0.5); break renders as a black slab in both motion-on fulls (1440-full-2.jpg, 390-full-3.jpg, -0.5). Habitat framing in hero is good.

copy.notes: Trade-true lines ('Mesh helps; it doesn't end the ladder.', 'No blower aimed at your garden.') answer brief fears; Sample everywhere, 0 em dashes. Five names for the pricing action across 1440-full-2/3/4/5.jpg (-0.5); h1 has no trade noun (1440-first.jpg); mixed card labels (1440-full-4.jpg).

mobile.notes: 390-full-0..9.jpg: hero restacked, plates stacked without pin, ledger re-laid name/price/bar, full-width form options, sticky bar, no overflow (render.json). 390-first.jpg: signature under the bar; 390-full-0.jpg: bar cells and month letters ~10px.

a11y.notes: Per-tone 3px focus, forced-colors, clean heading order, labelled ZIP. 1440-rm-full-0.jpg: hero inset photo is an empty bone rectangle in reduced motion (mustFix, cap 8.0); it shows in 390-rm-full-0.jpg.

motion.notes: Hooks: reveal, split, stagger, plate draw, sticky pindex with active row (1440-scroll-25.jpg), bar fills, form progress, clip break. h1 readable at first paint (1440-first.jpg). No single explanatory motion idea visible; break clip reveal left the frame black (1440-full-2.jpg).

wow.notes: Tree sorter writes into the signature bar and prints: right idea. 1440-full-3.jpg shows only the empty state ('Pick the trees over your roof.'), so the moment is invisible without input.

polish.notes: SVG favicon, apple-touch, OG, HomeAndConstructionBusiness JSON-LD, print and forced-colors CSS, designed footer with year bar (1440-full-6.jpg). Pill chips beside square options in one band (1440-full-3.jpg, -0.5); stray trailing dot in hero proof line (1440-first.jpg).

mustFix.problem: Hero habitat photo is blank (empty bone frame) in the 1440 reduced-motion capture
mustFix.fix: Ensure .inset__img has no opacity/clip/transform initial state outside .sw-motion, set loading=eager explicitly with a small srcset candidate for the 180px slot so it decodes before paint; re-run check-render and confirm it shows in 1440-rm-full

elevate.move: Turn the photographs into specimens: give the break frame a plate header (habitat: Bigleaf maple, November) with the rust November tick from the bar system on its lower edge, and bring a gutter/roof-edge frame in at size as a habitat plate in the field guide, all graded to the hero's warm fir-green

Make the resting state a finished field guide: in reduced motion and JS-off every bar is filled to its end state, every drawing fully drawn, every photo at rest, and the tree calendar shows a printed example selection so the tool reads complete without input
